def search(you, opp, depth, alpha, beta, deadline, tt, ply):
    if time.time() > deadline:
        raise TimeoutError()
    key = (you, opp)
    entry = tt.get(key)
    tt_move = None
    if entry is not None:
        e_depth, e_flag, e_val, e_move = entry
        if e_depth >= depth:
            if e_flag == EXACT:
                return e_val
            elif e_flag == LOWER and e_val > alpha:
                alpha = e_val
            elif e_flag == UPPER and e_val < beta:
                beta = e_val
            if alpha >= beta:
                return e_val
        tt_move = e_move
    moves = legal_moves(you, opp)
    if not moves:
        return -WIN + ply
    if depth == 0:
        return evaluate(you, opp)
    if tt_move is not None:
        # move ordering: place tt_move first
        for i, m in enumerate(moves):
            if (m[0], m[1]) == (tt_move[0], tt_move[1]):
                moves[0], moves[i] = moves[i], moves[0]
                break
    alpha_orig = alpha
    best_val = -INF
    best_move = moves[0]
    for m in moves:
        src, dst = m[0], m[1]
        new_you = (you & ~lsbit(src)) | (1 << dst)

    if best_val <= alpha_orig:
        flag = UPPER
    elif best_val >= beta:
        flag = LOWER
    tt[key] = (depth, flag, best_val, best_move)
    return best_val
